sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "invoice_lines"."invoice_id" AS e, "customers"."state" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "invoice_lines" JOIN "invoices" ON "invoices"."id" = "invoice_lines"."invoice_id" JOIN "customers" ON "customers"."id" = "invoices"."customer_id" GROUP BY "invoice_lines"."invoice_id", "customers"."state"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: share of the g total of number of invoice_lines records (g level)
gap to the all average of number of invoice_lines records: share of the g total (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "playlist_tracks"."track_id" AS e, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "playlist_tracks" GROUP BY "playlist_tracks"."track_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m2" > "s4"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: share of the all total of number of playlist_tracks records (all level)
gap to the all average of number of playlist_tracks records: share of the all total (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "invoices"."customer_id" AS e, "customers"."country" AS g, SUM("invoices"."total") AS m1 FROM "invoices" JOIN "customers" ON "customers"."id" = "invoices"."customer_id"  GROUP BY "invoices"."customer_id", "customers"."country"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s3"."m2" AS REAL) / "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: invoices.total amount charged on the invoice
why: total of total amount charged on the invoice per customers within customers.country (additive)
share of the g total of total of total amount charged on the invoice (g level)
index against the all average of total of total amount charged on the invoice: share of the g total (all level)
